# Static asset attributions

`codicons-chip.png` is the VS Code Codicons “chip” icon.
`favicon.png` (32×32) and `favicon-64.png` (64×64) are resized copies used for the site icon.

- Upstream: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons (MIT)
- Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Codicons_%E2%80%93_chip.svg
